_readme: EMC x TSC1/TSC2, ROUND 7 (re-issued), 2026-08-24. The first issue of round 7 returned 200 on 16 of 18 rows and was FAILED BY THE WORKFLOW because two were never answered -- correctly, since an unanswered question is not an empty result. Both failures were cbioportal 502/503 on the same heavy endpoint: /discrete-copy-number with discreteCopyNumberEventType=HETLOSS against pancan_pdmr_2025_gistic. THOSE TWO ROWS ARE DROPPED RATHER THAN RETRIED, because they are REDUNDANT, not because they failed: /molecular-data on the same gistic profile returns the discrete value for EVERY sample, which strictly CONTAINS the HETLOSS subset, and those rows returned 200 in the first issue. The discrete-copy-number endpoint is a filtered convenience view of data the molecular-data endpoint already gives in full. The same reasoning drops the other cohorts' HETLOSS rows, which returned 200 with an empty array while their molecular-data siblings returned megabytes -- so the empty arrays were never the reading. What remains is the instrument that actually answers the single-copy question: log2CNA (continuous copy number) for pancan_pdmr_2025's 9 EMC samples, plus discrete values for every other cohort with a copy-number profile.
